fields.label: Customer Organization
fields.description: The subscriber using PLUS POINT. Its workforce data lives in its own separate site database.

fields.label: Tenant Hostname
fields.description: The subscriber site address, not a work-site location. This address identifies its isolated tenant database.

fields.label: ERPNext Subscription
fields.description: The native subscription that determines trial, paid period and expiry for this customer organization.

fields.label: Suspended
fields.description: Stops document changes on the customer site after the operator worker synchronizes it, normally within one minute. Existing records remain readable.

fields.label: Worker Limit (0 = unlimited)
fields.description: Maximum active workers in this tenant; zero means unlimited.

fields.label: User Limit (0 = unlimited)
fields.description: Maximum enabled system-user logins in this tenant; zero means unlimited. Workers without logins do not use a user seat.

fields.label: Site Limit (0 = unlimited)
fields.description: Maximum active work locations inside the tenant, not the number of tenant databases. Zero means unlimited.
